alate: Head brown, thorax and abdomen brown or slightly paler, wing scales brown; head capsule and pronotum densely covered with short pubescence and scattered long setae. Head flat and rounded; fontanelle oval and depressed, a pale small dot in front of the fontanelle; compound eyes subcircular, their long diameter about five to six times the distance between them and the lower margin of the head; ocelli flat and rounded, their long diameter more than three times the ocellus-compound eye distance; labrum semicircular; postclypeus trapezoidal, about half as long as wide; antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest; antennal spot circular and of the same colour as the head capsule, situated in front of the ocelli and smaller than them; the anterior margin of the pronotum straight, the middle of the posterior margin straight or slightly concave.
distribution: Luodian, Guizhou; Xuwen, Taishan, Conghua and Huiyang, Guangdong; Lingao and Qiongshan, Hainan; Dongxing, Guangxi.
soldier: Head yellowish brown and densely covered with short pubescence, the tips of the mandibles brown tinged with red, antennae, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head square but rounded, the middle of the lateral margins slightly expanded, the anterior margin straight, the posterior margin broadly rounded; labrum nearly square, its tip straight or slightly concave; mandibles hooked, each with a large blunt tooth at or slightly before the apical third, and one minute sharp tooth above the base of each; antennae with 14 segments, the second longer than the third; the waist of the postmentum 0.27–0.36 mm wide, the waist region indistinct; pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the posterior margin straight or concave forwards.
